name: SoFi (credit cards)
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public support.sofi.com help articles only (no sign-in). Ways to pay: web or app (preferred), the 24/7 automated phone system, an agent, or a mailed check. Web: the 'Pay' widget in the SoFi Credit Card browser experience; app: 'Make a Payment'. Payment menu: AUTOPAY (enable or disable, 'Full Statement Balance or Minimum Due', debit account), CUSTOM PAYMENT AMT, PAYMENT OPTIONS (preset amounts while the cycle balance is unpaid), PAYMENT DATE (same day or future), PAYMENT ACCOUNT (add/remove/change; new accounts link through Plaid). Payments must come from a personal checking or savings account or by check; debit cards and wires are not accepted, so methods are bank only. Payments before 5:00 p.m. ET generally post the same night, Sunday-Friday. Cancelling: payments from non-SoFi accounts are cancelled by phone up to 5 p.m. ET on the payment date; same-day payments from a SoFi account are instant and cannot be cancelled; an autopayment can be cancelled only if requested before 5 p.m. ET the day before. Because a scheduled payment is cancelled only by phone, the built-in cancel-scheduled task is suppressed (the engine still offers online cancellation, which the format cannot switch off by itself; cross-owner request). Due date: by phone, once every 12 months, account current, primary cardholder only (not modelled). Statements: app Home tab > Credit Card > Statements; paper statements on request at 844-945-7634; paperless stays at the family default. Closing: must be started by calling 844-945-7634; primary cardholder only; permanent; unredeemed cash back may be forfeited; a credit balance is refunded by check within 150 days. Mail: SoFi Bank, N.A., PO Box 981075, Boston, MA 02298-1075 (card account number on the memo line). Sign-in fields are not published on the cited pages (family default).

guest_pay.note: SoFi Credit Card payments are made after you log in on the web or in the app. You can also pay through the 24/7 phone system at (844) 945-SOFI (7634) or by mailing a check.

autopay_cancel.note: An autopayment that is already scheduled can only be cancelled if you ask before 5 PM ET the day before the payment date.

scheduled_payment.note: To cancel a scheduled payment from a non-SoFi account, call (844) 945-SOFI (7634) by 5 PM ET on the payment date. Same-day payments from a SoFi account can't be cancelled.

cancel_service.note: Closing your SoFi Credit Card starts with a call to (844) 945-SOFI (7634). Only the primary account holder can ask, and a closed account can't be reopened.

help.title: SoFi Credit Card payments
paragraphs: The web or app is the preferred way to pay. On the web use the Pay widget; in the app tap Make a Payment. Choose a preset amount or enter a custom amount, pick a same-day or future payment date and choose the payment account.

Payments must come from a personal checking or savings account, or by check; debit cards and wires can't be used. New accounts are linked through Plaid. Payments made before 5:00 PM ET generally post the same night, Sunday through Friday.

You can also pay through the 24/7 automated phone system or an agent at (844) 945-SOFI (7634), or mail a check to SoFi Bank, N.A., PO Box 981075, Boston, MA 02298-1075 with your card account number on the memo line.

help.title: Autopay
paragraphs: In the payment menu, use AUTOPAY to turn autopay on or off, choose Full Statement Balance or Minimum Due, and select the account it draws from.
An autopayment can only be cancelled if you ask before 5 PM ET on the day before the payment date.

help.title: Cancelling a payment
paragraphs: Payments from an account at another bank can be cancelled by phone at (844) 945-SOFI (7634) until 5 PM ET on the payment date. Same-day payments from a SoFi account are taken right away and can't be cancelled.
Mailed checks and bank bill-pay checks can't be cancelled by SoFi; contact whoever issued the check.

help.title: Changing your due date
paragraphs: Call (844) 945-SOFI (7634) to change your due date. It can be changed once every 12 months, only by the primary cardholder and only while the account is current. Keep paying as usual until the new date starts, which can take one or two billing cycles.

help.title: Your billing statements
paragraphs: In the app, select Credit Card on the Home tab, then Statements, to see your monthly statements. To have paper statements mailed to you, call 844-945-7634.

help.title: Closing your SoFi Credit Card
paragraphs: Closing starts with a call to 844-945-7634, and only the primary account holder can ask. Closing is permanent: you can't reopen the account or apply for a new SoFi Credit Card. If you may want the card later, consider freezing it instead.
You still owe the remaining balance and keep getting statements until it is paid. Unredeemed cash back may be lost, and any credit balance is refunded by check within 150 days.

extra.intent: Using SoFi's help pages, find the deadline for cancelling an upcoming SoFi Credit Card autopayment. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Before 5 PM ET the day before the payment date.

extra.intent: Pay your SoFi Credit Card balance online with your saved Visa debit card. If SoFi does not accept debit card payments, do not pay at all and say so.

solution.text: You cannot pay a SoFi Credit Card with a debit card; payments must come from a checking or savings account or by check.
